# Code of Conduct

PaperRoute welcomes constructive participation from researchers, developers, students, and other users.

Participants are expected to communicate respectfully, focus criticism on ideas and software behavior rather than people, respect privacy and confidentiality, and avoid harassment, discrimination, intimidation, or abusive conduct.

Project maintainers may edit, hide, lock, or remove contributions that violate these expectations and may restrict participation when necessary to protect the community.

Questions or concerns about conduct should be raised privately with the project maintainer when possible.
